title: knema intermedia
intro: Knema intermedia, commonly known as the Sabah keruing or keruing, is a plant species belonging to the family Myristicaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian cultures to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Knema intermedia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
